'''2009 Worlds Day 2 Thomas McCord LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Thomas McCord]] at [[2009 World Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
